name: Cabo Poco Area
description: The sunlit southern cape where every Paldean journey begins, from the cobbles of Poco Path up through the olive-dotted fields of South Province Area One.

name: Mesagoza Area
description: The walled academy city of Mesagoza at the heart of the south, ringed by the terraced hills and dusty badlands of South Province Areas Two and Four.

name: Cortondo Area
description: The olive country west of Mesagoza — Cortondo's pressing mills, the rolling grass of Area Three, and the rockier reaches of Areas Five and Six.

name: Artazon Area
description: The garden town of Artazon and its endless sunflower fields, backed by the tangled brambles of Tagtree Thicket.

name: Levincia Area
description: The neon port city of Levincia on the eastern shore, wired through the storm-lit plains of East Province Areas Two and Three.

name: Cascarrafa Area
description: The oasis city of Cascarrafa raised above the sand, reached across the blistering dunes of the Asado Desert.

name: Medali Area
description: The food town of Medali in the western uplands, between the wide waters of Casseroya Lake and the scorched stone of Socarrat Trail.

name: Montenevera Area
description: The graveyard town of Montenevera in the frozen north, spanning the fighting grounds of North Province and the snowfields of Glaseado Mountain.

name: Area Zero
description: The Great Crater of Paldea — a sealed hollow at the centre of the region where impossible Pokémon from other times still walk.
